experiment_title: BOB57 24-plex pool on Illumina (NovaSeq X, 150 x 150 paired-end): 24 bobcoded samples, poly(A)-purified RNA, R1long-6N random-priming RT, 21 human HEK + 3 mouse RAW
construct_description: 5'-[P5][i5][TruSeq1 CTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCT][R1long-6N hexamer]...cDNA...[GGG][6N UMI+spacer][7mer bobcode][TruSeq2 AGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCT][i7][P7]-3'. ILLUMINA: TruSeq2 IS the R2 sequencing primer, so R2 BEGINS with the bobcode at position 0 (read_layout=r2_positional); R1 begins with the 6-nt priming hexamer (templated cDNA, not a UMI). The only UMI is the 6N on the TSO side. 23 seven-mers plus the 11-mer BOB25D (GATGACAGTAT) on the same anchor; species design as BOB57: 21 human (HEK) samples, 3 mouse (RAW) controls, so species accuracy sees human-to-mouse swaps only.
notes: Sequenced as one lane, 2 x 150 nt, 182 M read pairs, Q30 93.3%.

Read layout: read 2 begins with the bobcode at position 0 (read_layout=r2_positional); read 1 begins with the 6-nt priming hexamer (templated cDNA, not a UMI). The only UMI is the 6N on the TSO side; grun_offsets give the UMI + spacer length per code.
The three Ris dose 500mM samples (ACACCAT, CTCTTAC, GCGAATG) carry about 1% of the reads each (input failure; excluded from the benchmark, see config/units_excluded_24plex.tsv).

Library preparation: 18 ug bobcoded RNA input, poly(A) purification, about 700 ng RNA into RT (about 30 ng per sample) with 2 uM R1long-6N, exonuclease I digest; 8/10 of the cDNA (about 560 ng RNA equivalent) amplified for 15 cycles, double-sided SPRI, library 150 ng, fragment peak 376 bp.

Sample labels carry a legacy unit: the risdiplam arms are 25 nM and 500 nM, not mM. The labels are kept as identifiers because they name every output file; the treatments map above is the authoritative description.
